title: Ship a full repository snapshot in the foundation release
goal: Publish a git-archive repo.tar full-repository snapshot alongside the foundation release bundle so consumers rebuild deterministically from a locked release without a live base working tree.

in: repo.tar full-repository snapshot generation from git archive at baseCommit
repo.tar.sha256 sidecar and packing into the release .tgz
repo.tar(+sha256) as standalone GitHub release assets

syncExpectation: Ops consumes repo.tar from the locked GitHub release (v0.10.21+) instead of a live ../pantheon-base working tree.
